_comment: Tier-2 for skfem heat#5. The existing heat::0 fixture checks that a short x raises 'out of bounds'; this one pins the ARITHMETIC of the message and finds the asymmetry the claim does not mention. Measured on skfem 12.0.1 (MeshQuad 5x5, ElementQuad1, left+right constrained): a short x of length len(D)=10 raises IndexError 'index 20 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 10' -- the index is a GLOBAL DOF number and the size is len(x), which is why the numbers look unrelated to the BC. A too-LONG x does NOT raise at all: it is silently accepted and the extra entries ignored. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 builds the probe array x_short at the documented correct length -- basis.zeros(), i.e. basis.N -- carrying the same prescribed values, instead of at length len(D). Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 6 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'out of bounds for axis 0 with size 10', 'short_x_raises_indexerror=True', 'reported_index_is_a_global_dof_number=True' and 'reported_size_equals_len_short_x=True' so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
expect_in_output: out of bounds for axis 0 with size 10
